target: right measured gripper endpoint delta, target index7/preparedstate index19; source units, not command
static_rule: abs(delta)<=.01, inherited gripper target floor, fixed before evaluation analysis
boundary_rule: Median absolute nonstatic target among train128 only; small:(tau,boundary],large:>boundary; ties retained, empty bins allowed
prediction_detection: abs(prediction)>tau; otherwise missed movement when target active. Opposite signs count separately.
scope: Descriptive analysis of already observed evaluation predictions; no training, threshold selection or prediction correction from evaluation labels
